task.description: The worker's whole job in Markdown, since it knows nothing else: the goal in one sentence first, then the context it needs, what to inspect, what to return, and any constraints.

model.description: The id of the model the worker runs on, from Luke's catalog; your own where left out.

effort.description: The reasoning effort the worker runs at, one the model lists; your own where left out.

background.description: Ignored: the worker's answer reaches you on its own either way.
